verdict.rationale: OpenTofu ships CLI command documentation, but nothing in the evidence shows an interactive API reference or runnable examples. The probe for OpenAPI/Swagger specs found all candidate paths returning 404. Because a tooling ecosystem like this could plausibly offer such a reference, the axis applies, and the lack of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
